pages.title: Who Lives Here?
pages.text: Look up an unfamiliar creature before deciding how to approach it.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Search the recipe catalogue for Animal Dictionary or Field Guide. Their creature pages explain the matching species; neither book tames animals.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Animal Dictionary explains individual diets, behavior and uses. Replace a lost copy with book, green dye and an eligible mod item; the guide does not replace real activity objectives.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Use the installed Field Guide for woodland animals and cryptids; the author warns its online wiki is unreliable. Similar species need not behave alike.
